(Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources including at least one of network flow data, DNS query logs, or BGP routing table data__; analyze the network data __using machine learning algorithms trained on historical threat patterns__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by automatically implementing network isolation and access control modifications in real-time without human intervention__.
